craft_notes: Sthāyin: five principles by primacy. Rows: leads then is. Read aloud: five doors.

lines: Where knowing leads, the Śiva-truth; where bliss, the might-truth;
for will is of knowing and acting, of even embracing nature;
where knowing-might leads is the Sovereign-truth,
l4.sanskrit_cite: citprādhānye śivatattvam ānandaprādhānye śaktitattvam icchāprādhānye sadāśivatattvam icchāyā hi jñānakriyayoḥ sāmyarūpābhyupagamātmakatvāt jñānaśaktiprādhānye īśvaratattvam kriyāśaktiprādhānye vidyātattvam iti
